import { Transaction } from '../domain/transaction.js';
// Consumo cruzado permitido: solo vía contracts del otro contexto.
import type { PostEntryCommand } from '../../../ledger/src/contracts/index.js';
import type { AuditPort } from '../../../audit/src/contracts/index.js';

export const recordTransaction = async (cmd: PostEntryCommand, audit: AuditPort): Promise<Transaction> => {
  await audit.append({ workspaceId: 'w', action: 'transactions.transaction.recorded' });
  return new Transaction(cmd);
};
